summary: Describes an HTTP API that lets clients interact with a captive portal system, such as the login page at a coffee shop. Clients can discover how to get out of captivity and fetch state about their portal session. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: Public Wi-Fi often makes you click through a web page before you can go online. This document gives devices a standard way to ask the Wi-Fi about their session, such as how to get past that page.

questions: what is the captive portal api
how can a device find out about captive portal state
